create_IMUSensor: create an IMUSensor instance with configured channels, bounds, and optional noise generator
get_channels_IMUSensor: get the list of configured IMUChannel enum values from an IMUSensor instance
get_num_channels_IMUSensor: get the number of configured IMU channels from an IMUSensor instance
get_observation_IMUSensor: get the current IMU observation as a numpy array with optional noise applied
review_IMUChannel_enum: review the IMUChannel enum that defines ROLL, PITCH, YAW, and their rate variants
